### Get unique names & extract key!

```{r}
PD_2_run_names <- PD_PSMs_raw %>%
  select(file_path, `Spectrum File`) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(file_path_trm = str_remove(file_path, "^.*txt_exports/"), # rm b4 txt_exp/
         F_PD_key = str_remove(file_path_trm, "_PSMs\\.txt$")) %>% # strip end pattern
  
  separate_wider_delim(
    F_PD_key, 
    delim = "/", # split by folder
    names =  c("extra", "details", "PD_key"),
    too_few  = "align_end", # deal w uneven
    cols_remove = FALSE )
```

```{r}
anno_110_PD_key <- left_join(PD_2_run_names, anno_96,
                             by = join_by(`Spectrum File` == Run)) %>%
  
  #only_touch extra folder fikles 
  mutate(
    has_extra = !is.na(extra), # just those from the extra folder
    
    Mixture = if_else(has_extra, str_extract(PD_key, "(?<=_)B\\d+(?=_)"), Mixture),
    
    Fraction = if_else(has_extra,
                       as.numeric(str_extract(PD_key, "(?<=_F)\\d+")), Fraction), #1-8
    
    PoolRef = if_else(has_extra,
                      str_extract(PD_key, "(?<=_)(MP|FP)(?=_)"), PoolRef), #most
    
    PoolRef = if_else(has_extra & details == "gradientcheck", "MP", PoolRef), #rest
    
    RunYear = if_else(has_extra, 
                as.numeric(str_extract(PD_key, "(?<=[A-Z]{3})20\\d{2}")), RunYear)) %>%
  
   select(-c(has_extra, file_path, file_path_trm)) %>%
   rename(Spectrum_File = `Spectrum File`)
  
colnames(anno_110_PD_key)
head(anno_110_PD_key)
```

```{r}
                        by = join_by(`Spectrum File` == Spectrum_File)) %>%
    rename(Spectrum_File = `Spectrum File`) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Spectrum_File, extra:PD_key, Mixture:RunYear), as.factor))
  

# PSMs

                        by = join_by(`Spectrum File` == Spectrum_File)) %>%
```

#### MERGE for results stats.

```{r}
PD_ResStats_raw_names <- PD_ResStats_raw %>%
  select(file_path) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(file_path_trm = str_remove(file_path, "^.*txt_exports/"), # rm b4 txt_exp/
         F_PD_key = str_remove(file_path_trm,
                               "_ResultStatistics\\.txt$")) %>% # strip end pattern
  
  separate_wider_delim(
    F_PD_key,
```

## MS/MS

BINBIN CACLULATION

```{r}
# checks
# colnames(PD_MSMS_df)
# head(PD_MSMS_df)
# unique(MSMS_hist$`RT in min`)


# Lazy people's way! Make RT in min 1 min bin & summ PSMs per bin
MSMS_hist_96 <- PD_MSMS_df %>% #
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.na(extra)) %>% #4318318 | 3769151
  
  filter(`MS Order` == 'MS2') %>% # only MS2! 
  
  # round RT to the nearest min by setting round to 0 (0 dp)
  mutate(RT_min = round(`RT in min`), 0) %>%

  # group by sample run rep & then RT 1 min bin
  # group_by(Spectrum_File, RunYear, Mixture, TechRepMixture, Fraction, RT_min) %>%
  group_by(pick(where(is.factor)), RT_min) %>% #group by 

  #sum PSMs no. per 1 min bin
  summarise(Sum_PSMs = sum(`Number of PSMs`), # PSM equiv | same as non
            Unidentified = sum(`Number of PSMs` == 0), # precursor but id
            Identified = sum(`Number of PSMs` != 0), #aka id'd precursor
            n = n()) # MSMS equiv
```

```{r}
  scale_alpha_discrete(range = c(1, 0.3)) +
  labs(x = 'Retention Time (min)',

    legend.direction = 'vertical',

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#E7F1F9", color = "grey5", 
                                    linewidth = 0.1),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  )

plot(RT_hist_gg)
```

### Cleavages

```{r}
cleav_calc <- PD_PSMs_df %>%
  group_by(pick(where(is.factor))) %>% 
  mutate(PSMs = n()) %>% # obs/no. of rows in grouping - so no. PSMs per run
  add_count(`Number of Missed Cleavages`)  %>% # count of 0,1,& 2 miss cleav
  rename(miss_cleav = n) %>% # renames calc col (n) to a descriptive name
  mutate(miss_cleav_percent = round((miss_cleav/PSMs) * 100, 1)) # 1dp


cleav_stats <- cleav_calc %>%
  group_by(pick(where(is.factor))) %>% 
  select(c(`Number of Missed Cleavages`, # missed cleav (1, 2, or 0)
           PSMs:miss_cleav_percent)) %>% #PSMs + miss cleavs no. & %
  unique() # keep unique (which should be based on calc over the group)

cleav_stats$`Number of Missed Cleavages` = factor(
  cleav_stats$`Number of Missed Cleavages`,
  levels = c(0,1,2))
```

```{r}
cleav_gg <- cleav_stats %>%
  filter(is.na(extra)) %>%
  # filter(Mixture == "B4") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Fraction,
    # x = interaction(TechRepMixture, Fraction,
    #                 sep = ' ',
    #                 lex.order = TRUE),
             y = miss_cleav_percent,
             alpha = `Number of Missed Cleavages`))  +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = 'grey10', fill = "orange", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(miss_cleav_percent, '%')),
            position = position_stack(), vjust = -.3,
            size = 2.5, show.legend = F) + # show.legend = F removes the a
  facet_nested(Mixture~TechRepMixture, 
             scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,115, 25),
                     limits = c(-1,115)) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = label_wrap(7)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + # to avoid clipping @ top 
  guides(y.sec = 'axis') + # adds 2nd y axis (right side)
  scale_alpha_discrete(name = 'No. of Missed Cleavages', 
                       range = c(0.25,1)) + # 
  labs(y = 'Percentage (%)',
       x = 'Sample Test & LC-MS Run No.'
       ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
     panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),  # Removes space between panel 
  )

plot(cleav_gg)
```

```{r}
         Mixture = factor(Mixture, levels = c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4")))

anno_colors <- list(
  Fraction      = HpHF_colors,       # names "1".."8" match the factor levels
  Mixture       = Batch_colors,      # names "B1".."B4"
  TechRepMixture = setNames(c("#737373", "#bdbdbd", "#f0f0f0"), levels(anno_row$TechRepMixture)),
```

```{r}
# matrix df for heatmap &  PCAs
heatmap_matrix <- PD_PSMs_df_long  %>%
  group_by(Spectrum_File, Channel) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Spectrum_File, 
              names_from = Channel,
              values_from = Abundance) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Spectrum_File") %>% # set Accession to rowname
  as.matrix()

```

```{r}
ref_channels <- c("126", "127N")   # pool refs

# Order TMT chanel
chan_order <- c(setdiff(colnames(heatmap_matrix), ref_channels), ref_channels)
chan_order <- c(sort_by_channel <- setdiff(chan_order, ref_channels), ref_channels)

blocks <- c("B1", "B2", "B3", "B4") #


heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, chan_order]


heatmap_1 <- pheatmap(heatmap_matrix,
                      clustering_distance_cols = 'euclidean',
                      clustering_distance_rows = 'euclidean',
                      clustering_method = 'ward.D',
                      cluster_rows      = FALSE,
                      cluster_cols      = FALSE,
                      gaps_col = length(chan_order) - length(ref_channels),  # gap after 
                      gaps_row = c(24,48,72),
                      
                      # main = "QC Check - Mean Abundance Across Samples (55/56)",
                      show_rownames =  FALSE, # rms overplotted protein names
                      # border_color = "grey10",
                      annotation_row = anno_row, 
                      annotation_colors = anno_colors, 
                      annotation_names_row = F, 
                      annotation_names_col = F,
                      angle_col = 45, # sample names at an angle
                      fontsize = 9.5,
                      fontsize_col = 9,
                      border_color = "grey30",
                      )
# exported as 2026_01_19_pheatmap_QC_check_mean_abund_rm129_outlier_v1
# basic QC
```

Note need to drop those with "Abundance" or "Decoy" for counts to be the correct summary - seems cols with \# are the same

```{r}
PD_ResStats_df_cat_stats <- PD_ResStats_df %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Name, regex("Abundance|Decoy", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  # filter(str_detect(Name, "# " )) %>% # match | "# " & "#" the same
  separate_wider_delim(Name,
                       delim = " - ",
                       names = c("PD_stat_cat", "PD_stat_name"),
                       too_many = "drop") %>% # check @ this stage
  group_by(Spectrum_File, PD_stat_cat) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1)
  

mean(PD_ResStats_df_cat_stats$Count) # 16992.33  | 16992.33
colnames(PD_ResStats_df_cat_stats)
```

```{r}
  filter(details != 'spares'| is.na(details)) %>%
  # filter(TechRepMixture != 2 | is.na(TechRepMixture)) %>%
  filter(TechRepMixture == 1 | is.na(TechRepMixture)) %>%
  mutate(details = if_else(details == "gradientcheck", "GC", details,
                           missing = " ")) %>%
  mutate(TechRepMixture = if_else(!is.na(TechRepMixture), 
                                  as.character(TechRepMixture), " ")) %>%
  arrange(Fraction) %>%
  #__SPECIAL_CHECKS___________________________________________________
  
  # filter(Mixture %in% c("B1", "B2")) %>%
    # filter(Mixture %in% c("B3", "B4")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # filter(!is.na(extra)) %>%
  select(c(
    # Spectrum_File,
    RunYear,
           # extra,
           TechRepMixture, details,
    
           Mixture, Fraction, Proteins,
           # `Protein Groups`, 
           `Peptide Groups`,PSM_MS2, PSMs, `MS/MS Spectrum Info`, `Quan Spectra`,
           # PoolRef,
           # RunYear,
           # # extra,
           # TechRepMixture, details
    )) %>%
  # mutate(extra = if_else(is.na(extra), "used", extra)) %>%
   gt(
    # rowname_col = 'Spectrum_File', # needs 2 be in quotes
     # rowname_col = c('TechRepMixture', 'Fraction'), # needs 2 be in quotes
   rowname_col = c('Fraction'), # needs 2 be in quotes
     
    # groupname_col = 'testing_phase'
    groupname_col = c('Mixture')
  ) %>%
  
  cols_label(
    # `MS/MS Spectrum Info` = 'MS\u00B2 Info',
    `MS/MS Spectrum Info` = ' MS\u00B2 ',
    TechRepMixture = 'TR',
    Mixture = 'Batch',
    Fraction = 'HpHF',
    PSM_MS2 = 'PSM/MS\u00B2 (%)',
    `Peptide Groups` = "Peptides",
    `Quan Spectra` = " MS\u00B3 ",
    # PoolRef = 'PR',
    details = '+',
    RunYear = "RunYr"
  ) %>%
    tab_spanner(
    # label = 'PD 2.4 Summary Counts (B1 & B2 - 2021)',
    # label = 'PD 2.4 Summary Counts (B3 & B4 - 2022)',
    label = 'PD 2.4 Summary Counts (Extra Checks)',
    # columns = 4:9
    columns = 6:11
  ) %>%
 tab_spanner(
    label = 'Details',
    columns = 1:4
 ) %>%
  opt_vertical_padding(scale = 0.5) %>%
  
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#e7eef8")),
            locations = cells_body(
              rows = Fraction == 3 &  RunYear == 2022 & Mixture == "B1")) %>% 
  
  tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#d9e8ff")),
            locations = cells_body(
              rows = Fraction == 3 &  RunYear == 2021 & Mixture == "B1")) %>% 
  
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f5dbe5")),
            locations = cells_body(
              rows = Fraction == 3 &  RunYear == 2022 & Mixture == "B3")) %>% 
      tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#f8e7f5")),
            locations = cells_body(
   rows = Fraction == 3 &  RunYear == 2022 & Mixture == "B3" & details == "FP")) %>% 
  
  
    cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()) %>%
   tab_options(table.font.size=11,
               )
```
